observation: Trust infrastructure is mature enough for a breadth-expanding primitive; context compression is a cross-agent loss boundary.
prior_belief: Structured critical-field preservation can make compression auditable.
intervention: Built deterministic structured distillation plus exact critical-field loss audit.
failure_or_surprise: Contradictions must be preserved as first-class data, not reconciled during distillation.
reusable_lesson: A distiller should prove what it retained before optimizing how much it compresses.
invalidated_assumption: A concise summary is sufficient for safe agent handoff.
retry_condition: When representative unstructured histories are available.
